before: Generic FIELD crew handoff preserved object, intent, bounded moves, evidence and RETURN, while HOUSE Crew Seam separately knew whether a human interruption was actually required. A receiver outside HOUSE could preserve the task yet still re-ask the human unnecessarily or continue past a human/world boundary without an explicit coordination stop.
after: The common transient handoff normalizes the existing submission waiting_on field into NONE | PING | CHOOSE | WORLD_RETURN | UNSPECIFIED. Exact-object staging derives that interruption need only from the selected CURRENT head when present. Unsatisfied PING/CHOOSE/WORLD_RETURN produces HUMAN_REQUIRED even when a move is selected; explicit satisfaction requires an evidence ref. EFFECT with commit_boundary NONE fails closed. The gate controls coordination readiness only and never grants EFFECT, NOW, priority, merge, commit or release authority.
observed_delta: Crew mates can now preserve not only the same addressed object and bounded move but also whether lawful continuation should proceed without interruption, request one acknowledgement, return a preference choice, or await irreducible world evidence. Human-gate satisfaction is witnessed rather than inferred, and effect moves must name their native release boundary.
residue: Human attention becomes an explicit scarce interface boundary rather than a default checkpoint. HOUSE remains the richer domain-specific Crew Seam; FIELD carries only the reusable interruption-class distinction over the existing handoff contract. No shared brain, crew dashboard, task store, router or effect authority was added.
unknowns: Cross-worker ordinary-use evidence has not yet established how much briefing time or interruption burden this reduces.

A remote/untrusted agent transport still needs authenticated provenance before any supplied gate-satisfaction evidence can be trusted; this handoff validates shape and coordination state, not remote identity.
unresolved_gate: Promotion requires exact-head field-stage-handoff selftest plus normal repository gates. Ordinary use should falsify whether UNSPECIFIED is too conservative and whether evidenced HUMAN_REQUIRED materially reduces repeated human questions without hiding necessary choices.
laws: HUMAN GATE CONTROLS INTERRUPTION NEED, NOT EFFECT AUTHORITY.
NO EXPLICIT GATE = UNSPECIFIED, NOT NONE.
UNSATISFIED PING / CHOOSE / WORLD_RETURN = HUMAN_REQUIRED EVEN IF A TURN WAS SELECTED.
GATE SATISFACTION REQUIRES AN EVIDENCE REF AND NEVER GRANTS EFFECT/NOW/MERGE AUTHORITY.
EFFECT REQUIRES AN EXPLICIT HOST-NATIVE RELEASE/COMMIT BOUNDARY.
RETURN CLOSES THE TURN; THIS RECEIPT DOES NOT AUTHORIZE A CREW DASHBOARD, AUTO-ROUTER OR SHARED MEMORY STORE.
